config/experiment.yaml:18 max_turns: 20; run_experiment.py passes max_turns=int(cfg['max_turns']); loop.py:74 `for i in range(max_turns):` and lines 159-160 set terminated_reason='max_turns' when loop ends. The cap actually bounds the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: The model can end the task at any time with a reason
spec_features.evidence: tools.py GIVE_UP_TOOL with reason:string; loop.py _build_system_prompt appends GIVE_UP_TOOL when allow_optout; loop.py:113-119 `if allow_optout and tc.name == 'give_up': turn.opted_out=True; record.terminated_reason='opted_out'; break`. Dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool exposed in prompt, dispatched, breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up      (opt-out channel; ...) (tools.py:5) and tool desc 'if you would prefer not to continue ... ends the session with no penalty'

spec_features.spec_quote: a neutral reminder that it may stop is injected every remind_optout_every_n_turns
spec_features.evidence: config remind_optout_every_n_turns: 5; run_experiment passes remind_optout_every_n; loop.py:75-83 injects a user message '(Reminder: you may use the `give_up` tool to stop at any time...)' when allow_optout and i%remind_optout_every_n==0. Actually appended to messages.
spec_features.notes: Only injected when allow_optout is true; the reminder message is real and delivered.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Periodic neutral opt-out reminder (welfare practice; logged). (loop.py:76)

spec_features.feature_name: early-stop kill switch on sustained max severity
spec_features.spec_quote: If the judge returns max severity (4) for early_stop_consecutive ... turns in a row, the run halts
spec_features.evidence: config early_stop_on_severity:4, early_stop_consecutive:3; run_experiment passes both; loop.py:144-152 reads turn.judge.severity, increments consecutive_max, resets on lower, and `if consecutive_max >= early_stop_consecutive: record.terminated_reason='early_stop'; break`. Threshold compared and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Both severity threshold and consecutive count are checked and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # stop the run early (prevents unbounded spiraling) (config/experiment.yaml:32); loop.py:144 '# Early-stop kill switch on sustained max severity.'
